usage: 波鞋 are commonly used to refer to casual sports shoes or trainers in Hong Kong Cantonese.
You can use 波鞋 to talk about the shoes you wear for running, exercising, or casual outings.
When asking about or buying 波鞋, people usually discuss style, comfort, and brand.
The word 波鞋 is a noun, so it can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
You can add adjectives before 波鞋 to describe the type or color of trainers.
